```artifact
## Use-Cases & User Stories

**User Story 1:** As a patient residing within the Padmavathi Hospital zone, I want to be able to register and apply for appointments/consultation requests.

**User Story 2:** As a patient, I want my prescription requests to be routed to the authorized chemist based on my pincode.

**User Story 3:** As an authorized chemist, I want to deliver medicines to patients and collect payments.

**User Story 4:** As an authorized chemist, I want to mark prescriptions as completed upon delivery.

**User Story 5:** As a patient, I want to be able to track the status of my appointment, prescription, and laboratory services.

**User Story 6:** As a patient, I want to be notified when my medicines have been delivered.

**User Story 7:** As a patient, I want to be able to pay for my services online or upon delivery.

**User Story 8:** As a patient, I want to be able to access my medical records and test results.
```
